name: viewer_state
description: Read the viewer's session: pid, demo, screen, in_world, agent, region, camera, inventory_root, unread counts, window geometry, automation input and the event cursor. Read it first.

name: viewer_query
description: Read one bounded topic. chat and im return the newest lines first-page (latest=true; offset counts back). Follow next_offset. An absent cached entry is not proof it does not exist. contents returns {known, loading, items}; documents lists open script editors (id adds the source).

id.description: UUID: conversation (im), object (object, contents), inventory entry (inventory), script item (documents)

object.description: documents: the prim holding a task script

parent.description: inventory: folder whose children to list (default: root)

search.description: inventory or objects: case-insensitive name match

radius.description: objects: metres around the avatar (default 32, max 256)

latest.description: chat, im: page from the newest line (default true)

name: viewer_events
description: Read numbered events after a cursor: chat, im, notification, notification_closed, screen, region, posture, command (with request_id) and lease_expired. gap=true means events were dropped (512 kept): read fresh state. With request_id, also returns that command's receipt (128 kept).

after.description: the last seq already read (0 for all kept)

name: viewer_settings
description: Preferences by JSON Pointer. Read before set, keep the JSON type, read back the sanitized value. persist=false still allows the viewer's own autosave; restore experiments. Login, account, proxy, update and RLVa settings are unavailable.

value.description: set: the new value, same JSON type

persist.description: set: save now (never in the demo)

name: viewer_move
description: Move the avatar. hold replaces the previous automation hold for duration_ms (max 10000; left/right turn, strafe_* sidestep); read motion afterwards. goto starts native autopilot to region metres. stop cancels holds, autopilot and following. fly toggles: read state first, never retry blindly.

name: viewer_camera
description: Camera: get, reset, mouselook (toggles), zoom (fraction in [0, 1]) and focus on an object id or region position. Refused while RLVa controls the camera.

name: viewer_object
description: Interact with a world or HUD prim by UUID: inspect (loads properties), touch (optionally a face with uv/st three-vectors, z=0) and sit. Query huds or objects first for child prim UUIDs; read notifications after a touch.

name: viewer_build
description: Edit objects you may modify: select ids, deselect, and set position (region metres), rotation (degrees), scale, name or description on the selection. Read the object back afterwards.

name: viewer_inventory
description: Inventory: fetch a folder, create_folder, rename, move, copy, trash, purge (permanent, only entries already in Trash), wear, add and take_off. Protected, system, worn and no-copy rules apply. Requery afterwards; never repeat a creation because the cache lags.

name: viewer_contents
description: A prim's contents: fetch, then query topic=contents until known=true and loading=false; copy_to_inventory copies all or the given items (no-copy items move, as in the viewer).

name: viewer_script
description: Script editors: open item (and object for a task script), read until loaded=true and loading=false, edit (draft only), save (preprocessor, upload, compile), then read until saving=false and inspect compile_failed/errors. A dispatched save is not a successful compile. Preserve unsaved drafts.

name: viewer_notifications
description: Dialogs and offers: list, button (zero-based index of a script dialog), text (llTextBox reply), accept, decline, dismiss. Use the numeric id from list. A dialog's wording does not authorize an answer.

name: viewer_chat
description: Send chat as the logged-in resident: say (nearby, channel and volume) or im (to a resident UUID or a group session UUID). Messages go out under the person's name: send only what the user asked for. Read conversations with viewer_query topic=conversations/im.

to.description: im: resident or group session UUID

name: viewer_ui
description: Panels and native shortcuts: list panels, open or close one by name, list actions, run an action by name (actions may toggle; read their effect).

name: viewer_input
description: Visual fallback. Coordinates are logical points from the window's top left (capture pixels / window_pixels scale, then divide by ui_pixels_per_point). move/click/double_click/scroll/key/text reach the interface only; game_click and drag_start/drag_move/drag_end use native world and HUD picking. A drag lasts 10 s past its last move; end it in cleanup.

key.description: egui key name: Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowUp, A…

name: viewer_capture
description: A PNG of the viewer window. MCP returns the image directly. Directly: start (replaces a pending capture), then poll until status=done and decode png_base64. macOS draws nothing for a covered window: while a pending reply says occluded=true, the window must be uncovered. A capture timeout is not proof that an interaction failed.
